notes.title: BIG PATCH 1.05 - RELEASED !!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Coal Miners,

After a lot of work, we are finally able to share with you the newest and biggest yet update to our game.
We have fixed numerous bugs and also added and improved some features pointed by all of you.
We hope you will all enjoy our game even more from now on and be sure to check out all the changes.
To all of you who have supported our game, enjoyed it, played it and commented on it, thank you very much, it means a lot to our team. 

Patch Notes: 
[list]
[*][b]UI improvements:[/b]
[*]Added information for the player on the tablet about the "work speed" upgrade of employees in percentages starting from 100% upwards;
[*]Added information for the player about connecting a transport vehicle before assigning a drilling vehicle;
[*]Improved the HUD taking into account each language.
[*]Improved the HUD
a. Added an overlay behind the text in the control description for each vehicle;
b. Improved the position of the vehicle control description on the graphical interface
c. Changed the graphics in the HUD of acquired resources
d. Improving text readability
e. Changed the position of Tutorial and Map tooltips and improved their readability
[*][b]Game Features:[/b]
[*]Added the "work speed" upgrade for workers, increasing the speed of the task performed for the assigned vehicle;
[*]Added a load function for transport vehicles depending on the amount of material in:
a. "Underground Truck";
b. "Excavator";
c. "Loader".
[*]Added new options in the "Workshop" tablet - the ability to repair tires of purchased vehicles and refuel them for a fee.
[*]Added instructional videos to the knowledge compendium in the pause menu
[*]Added the option of towing the "PickUp" vehicle to a gas station for a fee in case of an empty tank.
[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[*]Fixed the deduction of money after clicking the "Upgrade" button;
[*]Reduced the salary for a day's work of employees.
[*]Fixed a bug that blocks the entire game in one of the three available mines - resetting the assignment of an order for workers and the vehicle to which it was assigned when exiting and entering the mine;
[*]Improved the assignment of a vehicle with a worker to a rock cell in the mine. Blocking the possibility of assigning a drilling vehicle before assigning a transport vehicle.
[*]Changed vehicle parameters
[*]Fixed the removal of the vehicle model after selling it using a tablet;
[*]Increased the range of connecting transport vehicles to the production line.
[*]Fixed wheel turning animations in vehicles
[*]Improved crane mechanics, increasing bucket loading speed
[*]Improved readability of instructions for packing cargo on a barge or train
[*]In case of "connecting" a vehicle, it is "disconnected" when its position is reset
[*]Fixed vehicle refueling mechanics - now vehicles cannot drive on an empty tank.
[/list]

Remember to leave us feedback after playing the patched version.

See you soon,
Grande Games

notes.title: BIG PATCH 1.05 - INCOMING!
notes.content:
Coal Mining Simulator - Big Patch 1.05 Incoming 

Greetings miners!

We are excited to announce that a new patch is on its way for Coal Mining Simulator, packed with exciting new features, optimizations, and improvements that will enhance your gameplay experience. Here are some of the highlights of what's coming:

Optimization Fixes:
We've heard your feedback and have worked hard to optimize the game. The new patch will address several performance issues and make the game run smoother on all platforms.

Improved Graphics and Textures:
Our team has been hard at work improving the game's visuals, adding new textures and lighting effects that will make the environment feel more realistic and immersive.

Improved Vehicles Controls:
Driving our vehicles will be easier and more realistic with the improved controls. The feedback we received from our community has been invaluable in this process.

More Jobs That Our Workers Can Do:
We are adding new jobs that our workers can do, expanding the possibilities for you to earn more money and advance through the game.

Added New Gameplay Mechanics:
We are introducing new gameplay mechanics that will add more depth and complexity to the game, providing more opportunities to explore and grow your mining business.

Improved Tutorials:
We understand that it can be challenging to learn all the intricacies of running a successful mining operation. That's why we've improved our tutorials to make them more intuitive and informative.

We hope you are as excited as we are about these updates. We want to thank our community for the valuable feedback they have given us. Your support and dedication have been crucial to making Coal Mining Simulator the best game it can be.

We are still hard at work on this patch, so we can't say specific date yet, but expect it to drop somewhere in the early June.

Keep an eye out for the patch, and we'll see you in the mines!

notes.title: Coal Mining Simulator Devlog - Release Date 11.04.2023
notes.content:
Hello Dear Fans,

Today we have great news for you. After many months of hard work and nearly a year after our Prologue was released, we finally have a release date for the full version of Coal Mining Simulator.

You will all be able to start your journey as Coal Miner on 11th of April 2023, so you will have to wait only one week. It has been a long and tough journey for our team, but we are very happy that you will all finally be able to enjoy our game. 

We have made numerous changes to our game, based on the feedback we received from all of you after Prologue. We wanted to showcase some of the improvements to UI and to graphics that our team has made in a recent year, so here you can see some before and after screenshots from the Coal Mining Simulator.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/914907254669594634/1092728056839405598/cmsw1.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/914907254669594634/1092728057657315349/cmsw2.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/914907254669594634/1092728058500354100/cmsw3.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/914907254669594634/1092728055279128616/cmsw4.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/914907254669594634/1092728056155754566/cmsw6.png[/img]

We can’t wait for all of you to finally test the full version of our game. We have added multiple new machines, mechanics and quests to the game. We have also created a big open world environment for you to enjoy. So be sure to save a date of 11.04.2023 and be ready to start your coal mining journey.

All the best,
Grande Games

notes.title: Coal Mining Simulator: Prologue POSTPONED
notes.content:
[h1]MINERS![/h1]

Due to certain circumstances, with heavy heart we need to [b]postpone the release of Coal Mining Simulator: Prologue[/b]. Yes, new date will be [b]April 21st[/b]

But fear not, there are reasons for us to take such steps. More precise- one big! Yes everybody- we're adding [b]OPEN WORLD![/b] How cool is that?

After lot of requests, suggestions and brain storms, we've decided to add more realism to our game and forge actions and tasks you can do in the game in actuall interactive actions. 

[b]But what actually you can do in the open world?[/b]

[b]Refuel your vehicles -[/b] You will be able to visit our gas station where you will refuel your car and jerry cans, so that you can bring fuel to other machines inside your mine.

[b]Visit our Shop - [/b]You will have a chance to visit our warehouse shop where you will buy mining equipment such as: dynamites, gas detectors and even new wheels for your vehicles.

[b]-Drive around the city-[/b] you could enjoy your wievs while going into the mine, but what about

[b]-Refuel your vehicles and repair them- [/b] You cannot have those not taken care of right? :)

[b]-Enjoy your time- [/b] Just simply chill between your missions and ejoy your free time!

[b]What more?[/b]

[b]Languages:[/b]
English
French
Italian
German
Spanish - Spain 
Japanese
Simplified Chinese
Traditional Chines
Korean
Polish
Portugese (Brazil)
Russian

[b]Full controler support[/b] Yes! Now you can enjoy the world of coal mining without even touching your mouse and keybord. That might be enticing tought for all those console-loving gamers!

And check out this simple video, we have prepared for you:

[previewyoutube=V8yaLc8KvbU;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for your patience and consideration!

Till next time!

notes.title: Devlog #18- Excavator
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dear Coal Miners![/h1]

Today we would like to share with You our brand new machine: [b]Excavator.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/2e45268ed5bdc7d8ac9eebd15d3aaa4ddb82f70d.jpg[/img]

After processing raw coal with coal washers You will have to transport it for sale.
Coal washers will create pile of processed coal on the ground so you will need a very flexible machine.

[previewyoutube=fejOkwLij3k;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see in the video thanks to advanced rig we achieved the ability to move three arms in all three axis.

To dig up hole we need to modify terrain, and apply new texture to it. We used shape keys to fill the excavator bucket. This technology is also used to fill the semi truck. A lot of particle systems needed to be created for best visual experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/20ba578600d82e0201cdc2d06b0a9dc93bbd7931.jpg[/img]

In the final release you will also have the ability to choose different companies to sell your coal to. 
 Different companies will have different profits and various consequences, so remember to choose wisely.
This machine is still a work in progress so we are open for all your suggestions about the improvements, if you have any. So be sure to leave us comments below, saying what you think about our excavator.

notes.title: Devlog#16 - Classifying Screen
notes.content:
Hello Dear Coal Miners.

Our team is hard at work adding new features and machines to the game, some of them based on suggestions you made after playing the demo. In today’s Devlog we would like to show you the first part of our Coal Washer machines.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/444aaf99bbee6a5108ba749eb8cee88cea3068e9.png[/img]

Classifying Screen will be used to separate bigger parts of Coal from smaller ones, as well as to separate coal from regular rocks.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/980fcae034e8ed3bccf1404dfad67228814f16fd.png[/img]

This is just the first of three machines that you will be able to use in the process of coal washing. Can you guess which are the other two? 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/0c1a1f4d89a6ace482658540f542300eeea37173.png[/img]

As always remember to leave us your feedback and be sure to add our game to your Steam Wishlist and remember to join our Discord channel to be able to chat with our entire team. See you in the next Devlog.

notes.title: Devlog #16
notes.content:
Hello Dear Coal Miners,

⛰️In Devlog#13 we showed you a little sneak peak on Coal Shearer.

⛰️Today it’s time for you to see it in action:

⛰️First of all you need to prepare space for supports, place drill at starting position, move away for safety reasons and turn on the machine using a designated controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/af6b2fdc06e9ea9561c6e97a1c17b8f7a13573c8.png[/img]

All these supporters are pretty expensive, so your mine has to be well developed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/a30287da3d4633e774bdfdc67ebfd0f9c74cd2a4.png[/img]

⛰️But you will get rewarded for your effort because Coal Shearer is fully automated. You only set direction, speed, a few other parameters, and the rest is done for you. You can leave it as it’s working and go to other machines to mine coal or just get a cup of coffee. Just remember to check on it from time to time to make sure everything is working as intended.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/ba8815f8ae35346535410b61e1b1302efcffd32f.png[/img]

⛰️You can also check out how this whole process works in our latest gameplay clip.


[previewyoutube=e8b_2pZyUiY;full][/previewyoutube]


⛰️Also let us know how do you like the demo?


⛰️You can talk to us on Discord - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]LINK![/url]

notes.title: Coal Mining Simulator Steam NEXT Festival Livestream #2
notes.content:
Hello Dear Miners,

Our team is extremely happy with your reception of our demo during the Steam NEXT Festival. We are writing down all of your suggestions and critiques to make sure we deliver the game that you will all enjoy playing. 

If there are some of you who have not checked our demo yet, be sure to not wait too long as Festival ends on October 7th. 

Also if you didn't have a chance to watch it before, there is a pre-recorded livestream happening still, where we are waiting for your questions in the comments and also you can watch our livestream video to learn more about our ideas for the game and what will be available in the full release.

notes.title: Coal Mining Simulator Steam NEXT Festival Livestream
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dear Coal Miners[/h1]

We are extremely happy to welcome you, to our Steam NEXT livestream.

We hope you will enjoy our show and also the ability to talk with our developers. 
We are super excited that you will all finally have a chance to play our game for yourselves.
Remember to leave us feedback and questions regarding the game, either during livestream where our team will be available to chat with you and answer all your questions, as well as on Discussion Tab of our Steam Page. 

Be sure to download our demo and leave a review with your thoughts on it. Also remember to Add Coal Mining Simulator to your Steam Wishlist so that you will be informed as soon as we post any new info regarding our game. 

Thanks for being with us and we hope you will enjoy this Steam NEXT show that we have prepared for you.

notes.title: Devlog #14
notes.content:
Hello Dear Coal Miners,

⛰️In the last devlog we wrote about Coal Shearer - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1118110/view/3001072145191012717]LINK![/url]

⛰️Today we would like to show you another mechanic in our game.

⛰️Last time we showed you how to operate Drill Rig, this time it is something a bit more dangerous. 
As you all probably know, working in mines is a dangerous task and as a miner you always have to be careful and mindful of your surroundings. That is why you will have to use Gas Detector to measure levels of dangerous gases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/482b5389c920b8337102c7af50edec388d8e6fa2.jpg[/img]

⛰️When they become too high like in the picture below, you will have to return to your HUB area to hide inside security compartment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/a06917176e8d56738d29a82db41f026d85fda92e.jpg[/img]

⛰️While you are inside you have to wait for the information that it is safe outside before you can step out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/216d2aeaa072bb0011462986791438ec0b41419d.jpg[/img]

⛰️That is all for today Devlog. We hope you are all as excited for this game as we are. Stay tuned for more information coming soon.



Remember about safety regulations!
Check out our [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]Discord![/url]
Stay tuned for more news!
Coal Mining Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #12
notes.content:
Hello Dear Coal Miners, 

🏔️In our latest Devlog we showed you how you can use Drill Rig and dynamite to blow rocks in order to gather coal and prepare space for new tunnels. 

🏔️This time we want to show you management view, which will allow you to control your whole mine. You will be using it to: build new tunnels, expand your mine, build railroad tracks and manage your workers.


[previewyoutube=GunpwVI9AJc;full][/previewyoutube]

🏔️In the successive development of the mine, it is important to combine micro and macro management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/0f367f5ef1fbf43ec8bd745885db27694fed80cf.png[/img]


🏔️We must take care of the extraction of coal in the shaft, but also take care of the budget for technological and equipment development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/08736dc0115f457732ded1b286ed20f5f62d22b5.png[/img]


🏔️What do you think about such solutions in Coal Mining Simulator?


Remember about safety regulations!
Check out our [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]Discord![/url]
Stay tuned for more news!
Coal Mining Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #11
notes.content:
🏔️Hello Dear Coal Miners, 

🏔️Several months ago, we showed you a model of the Underground Drill Rig - a machine useful for tasks that require a little bit more precision and finesse. Now, we would like to present you with our finished model. In Coal Mining Simulator, you will use this machine to drill holes where you will plant explosives. 

🏔️First of all here are some reference pictures from coal mine in Norway:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/9691eae85c01fba5a85c67e4e73ed3ab5604d69e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/44f129853dae8d15c49629b0f89d48f3da4439b4.jpg[/img]

🏔️And here are some video references:

[previewyoutube=v1B3wziazqc;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=fKzI9hwe5kY;full][/previewyoutube]

🏔️To achieve such mobility we had to use advanced rigging mechanics:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/878214cb2e9059cdfd39891e2b9b82b4d73f6991.png[/img]

🏔️After a lot of programming and 3D work, we achieved results seen in the pictures and films below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/7574f484141d9611694f15dd34b59e8023adb077.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/89d0f642f5cca355cf40946648a0d1f74c015bb6.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=6S3Ju6FQWMg;full][/previewyoutube]

🏔️After creating holes and inserting dynamite, we are ready to make some big explosions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/50f9b8ed7d37325a305371b1bf4580b21914c2ef.png[/img]


Remember about safety regulations! 
Stay tuned for more news! 
Coal Mining Simulator Team

🏔️However, we do not want to leave you without any news, so we decided to present you another machine that is ready to work in the mine. ⚙️

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.content:
Hello Dear Coal Miners, 🏔️


🏔️To begin with, we would like to thank you for receiving our devlogs so well and actively participating in our community on discord!⚙️


🏔️Today we will discuss the possibilities offered by our tablet. It is the main tool for managing our mine.⚙️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/0126a6b57b530bdfb02e25350ca9b3b99cee107b.png[/img]


🏔️Our tablet will allow us to review goals and missions, as well as to purchase new machines or other items, such as explosives.⚙️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/06a536cafa495fe650176ab934c9517c04d5eb0c.png[/img]


🏔️As you can see, it is solidly constructed, so it is resistant to dust, which is ubiquitous in coal mines.⚙️

🏔️Management is not only about purchasing, but also the efficiency of our mine's extraction. On the tablet, we will also check new equipment for which it will be worth collecting funds because it will significantly improve the extraction process.⚙️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35845252/e6b8e4b2ef47c0c9950a3eae431311fe168241b6.png[/img]



We would also like to invite everyone to our Discord where we will be happy to answer all your questions about the current work - [url=https://discord.gg/jQnsk3AhJ7]DISCORD[/url]
